0.method: dense EXACT (composite == golden, C4, 전역위상 무시)

1.method: Merkle(자식 sealed u_hash + 배선). ⚠ unitary 동등성 미증명

unitary_equiv.method_en: exact unitary equality vs an independent golden (dense C4 / Clifford tableau / ZX)
unitary_equiv.honest_boundary: global phase ignored; Tier-3 ZX is conservative (safe false-negative)

structural_wellformed.method_en: Merkle over sealed child u_hashes + wiring; unitary equivalence NOT proven
structural_wellformed.honest_boundary: structural ≠ dense — whole-unitary identity is not established

unitary_equiv_column_exact.method_en: full Shor unitary verified column-by-column (H·iQFT included) vs spectral formula
unitary_equiv_column_exact.honest_boundary: float-atol grade (Tier-0 dense C4 class), not ring-exact

compositionally_verified.method_en: exhaustive modexp permutation + ring-exact iQFT + H-wall, composed (n≥19 Shor)
compositionally_verified.honest_boundary: composition argument (not whole-column dense); stronger than subspace, weaker than column_exact

subspace_permutation_verified.method_en: modexp core exact permutation on the computational basis (independent integer arithmetic)
subspace_permutation_verified.honest_boundary: modexp core only; full unitary (H·iQFT) not verified (INV-R5)

unclassified.method_en: no explicit tier and empty/unrecognized contract
unclassified.honest_boundary: fail-closed — excluded from headline; never inferred as a strong grade
